title: Comment on C-143 "iPhone: turn on Do Not Disturb or Sleep focus for the scree…": Can you probe this Do Not Disturb or Sleep focus is turn on ?

anchor.label: iPhone: turn on Do Not Disturb or Sleep focus for the screen recordings

messages.text: Can you probe this Do Not Disturb or Sleep focus is turn on ?

Yes: I can check it from the recordings themselves, without asking you, and it was on.
- How: the phone's status bar is in every recording. With Do Not Disturb on, iOS shows a moon next to the clock (Sleep shows a bed), per Apple's list of iPhone status icons.
- Checked now: the Day 8 menu recording from 04:12 UTC shows the moon. Only the status bar strip was cut out (clock, signal, battery; nothing personal).
- From now on: no more Do Not Disturb steps for you. Each new article recording gets this status-bar check before any GIF is made, and you only hear from me if the moon is missing.
- Saved as a team rule (project memory), so every agent follows it.
- Longer term: a small automatic check in the recording tool could flag a missing moon by itself; I'll only build it if a recording ever misses it.
What you need to do: nothing.
